name: street_dog
about: A street dog of Việt Nam (chó cỏ): a medium dog of mixed breed with a short tan coat, about 50 cm at the shoulder, ears up, a tail that curls up.
sources: The size is a guess from photos and from the medium breeds of dogs (about 15 kg): no measurements. The template is a Shiba Inu, a dog of the same shape (ears up, a curled tail).
The lengths of the fur (fur): a guess from photos of the animal, not a measurement.
